# Traceability Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the end-to-end traceability chain and orphan detection are specified and measurable.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the full chain (requirement → scenario → decision → design → ADR → task → code → test → validation → documentation → evidence) defined, with the carrier of each link? [Completeness, CON X; Plan §13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is a stable ID scheme defined for every artifact type in the chain? [Clarity, Spec §Source and Classification Conventions; Plan §13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is orphan-task detection specified (every task cites requirements and tests)? [Completeness, CON Development Workflow; Plan §13] [D27] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is bidirectional traceability required at both run level (engine) and repository level (tool)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-008; Plan §13] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the traceability output (EV-008, docs/traceability.md) specified together with its failure condition? [Completeness, Plan §13] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the completeness criterion quantified (every C/D requirement has at least one test and at least one doc or evidence item)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007] [D26] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is orphan-implementation detection specified precisely (which source modules are in scope, and what counts as being referenced by a task)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-010 (CR-003); Plan §13] [D28] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is orphan-test detection specified with the exact form of a requirement ID tag, and is its inclusion in EV-008 stated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-OBS-010 (CR-003); Plan §13] [D29] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is staleness detection specified (evidence older than the hash of its source artifact)? [Completeness, Plan §13] [D30] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the mapping between run-level RQ IDs and spec IDs specified, including how unmatched statements are handled? [Ambiguity, data-model.md Requirement.spec_refs] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified how plan-level decisions (PD IDs, Human Gate rulings, CR records) trace into requirements and tests? [Gap, Plan §15; Plan Change Log] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
